Population increased in Bedford

The estimated population of Bedford in 2024 was 194,976 usual residents, a rise of 1.8% since 2023.

This meant that Bedford's rate of population change placed it among the 20 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Bedford increased by 4.9%.

Over this slightly longer period, Bedford was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Bedford

The average (median) age fell to 39.6 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Bedford has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Bedford is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Bedford's population of 194,976 usual residents was made up of:

  • 39,483 people aged 0 to 15 years, (20.3%)
  • 122,104 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62.6%)
  • 33,389 people aged 65 years and over, (17.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Bedford has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (20.3% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Bedford, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Bedford
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Bedford, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 501 people (0.3%). In total, there were 2,084 births and 1,583 deaths in Bedford.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 807 (0.4%). There were 10,726 people entering the area and 9,919 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Bedford's population of 2,121 (1.1%) as a result of 3,254 people entering the area and 1,133 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Bedford was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Bedford in mid-2023 is 191,575.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,121 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 563 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,684 people.
